verdict.rationale: New Relic documents in-product AI features that cover this story: AI insights give AI-powered summaries of workload health, performance trends and potential issues. New Relic AI lets users ask questions and troubleshoot telemetry in plain language, and the vulnerability agent drafts step-by-step remediation recommendations. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and deeper docs on how proactive suggestions are generated across data types.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI insights provide AI-powered summaries of your workload's health, performance trends, and potential issues.
It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.
Have AI identify friction points for you.
the agent triages the CVE, provides an analysis, drafts step-by-step remediation recommendations
